description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value of this parameter. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
The ID of the Express Connect circuit.

description.zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query region IDs.

descriptions.zh: 只能取消处于**Initial**、**Approved**、**Allocated**和**Confirmed**状态（未开通状态）的物理专线接入。
descriptions.en: You can cancel access only for Express Connect circuits that are in the **Initial**, **Approved**, **Allocated**, or **Confirmed** state (not yet activated).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc cancel-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm70000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
